ED seizes assets in separate cases of alleged excise and export fraud

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has seized assets worth ₹13 crore in connection with an alleged excise department scam and ₹55.57 crore in a separate case involving fraudulent mobile exports. In the excise case, allegations suggest illegal liquor sales were conducted under the names of excise department officials or their relatives. The mobile export case involves alleged fraud in the export of mobile phones.
